name: flow-story-maker
description: Turns a story idea into a production-ready prompt package for Google Flow and Veo 3.1: a text-only story overview, a timestamped clip map, one reference-image prompt, and a copy-ready video prompt per clip, including a Tagalog horror-riddle path and a mukbang ASMR path.

interface.longDescription:
Flow Story Maker turns a rough story idea — or a single photo — into a production-ready prompt package for Google Flow and Veo 3.1. It runs a short two-form interview, plans the story, then delivers: a text-only story overview, a clip map with allocated timestamps, one reference-image prompt for the whole run, and a copy-ready video prompt for every clip, each carrying its own timestamp header, audio direction, and a binding to the reference image's look. Two specialised paths ship with it: a Tagalog horror-riddle story whose riddle stays spoken and never appears on screen, and a mukbang ASMR story that stays silent of speech and uses eating sounds. It also revises a single item on request — change the riddle text, or the character or art style, and it re-emits only the prompts that carry the change.

Intended for creators who write video stories by hand in Flow and want continuity-safe prompts across clips, rather than a single one-off prompt.

Limitations: it produces text prompts and plans only — it does not generate video, does not upload to Google Flow on the user's behalf, and does not guarantee any particular model output. It works inside the conversation; there is no account, no sign-in, and no data collection.
capabilities: Plan multi-clip video stories with a timestamped clip map
Write Google Flow / Veo 3.1 video prompts per clip
Write mukbang ASMR prompt packages from a food photo
Revise a single plan item and re-emit only the affected prompts
defaultPrompt: Plan a 3-clip Tagalog horror riddle story with a Flow prompt per clip.
Turn this food photo into a mukbang ASMR prompt package.
Revise just the riddle text and give me the updated clip prompts.

publication.release_notes: First public release: two-form interview, text-only story overview, timestamped clip map, one reference image per run, per-clip Flow prompts with timestamp header, audio direction and reference-image binding, Tagalog horror-riddle path, mukbang ASMR path, and single-item revision.
